channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: Senado vota proposta nesta quarta-feira; acompanhe em tempo real
item.description: The Brazilian Senate will vote on Wednesday (10/14) a proposal to end the 6x1 scale of the Income Tax, one of the main campaign pledges of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The measure, which simplifies the tax system by reducing the number of income tax rates from six to one, moves forward after Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) declared support for the text, gathering backing from lawmakers across different parties for the first round of voting.

item.title: Meta AI se recusa a fazer material eleitoral para Lula, mas cria para Flávio
item.description: Meta AI, an AI tool by Meta on WhatsApp, refuses to create campaign materials for President Lula (PT) but complies with similar requests for Flávio Bolsonaro. The inconsistency in the company's policy application raises concerns about potential biases in electoral content generation.

item.title: Tarcísio diz a empresários que Flávio será ‘maior do que o pai’
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas claimed that Flávio Bolsonaro will be greater than his father, Jair Bolsonaro, at a business event, criticizing President Lula and calling for support at a downtown São Paulo rally. Flávio emphasized plans to reduce bureaucracy and denied intentions to cut social programs.

item.title: FLÁVIO BOLSONARO: NÃO TEM "CLIMA" DE JÁ GANHOU - JORNAL DA OESTE PRIMEIRA EDIÇÃO - 14/10/2026
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is portrayed as a candidate without a guaranteed victory climate, facing a competitive electoral scenario in 2026. The content analyzes his political trajectory after leaving the presidency and how it may impact his positioning for the elections. The narrative questions the assumption of an immediate win for the former minister.

item.title: Assinatura digital: até a IA indica certificadora que não emite mais.
item.description: Serasa Experian stopped issuing digital certificates in February 2024, but ChatGPT still recommended the company among the best certifiers in September 2026 due to outdated information. The increasing use of digital certificates in Brazil, with over 15 million active copies, requires users to check the official ITI list and verify the credentials of companies before purchasing the service. Alvo Certificado Digital, a registered Authority, emphasizes the importance of validating the issuer's identity and warns against sharing passwords or files through insecure channels.

item.title: Deputados apagam fake news sobre Satanás em ato de Lula na Paulista
item.description: Federal deputies from PL, Zé Trovão and Paulo Bilinskyj, posted and then deleted a manipulated video falsely accusing Lula of invoking Satan during a rally on Paulista Avenue. Lula's campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE requesting an injunction to remove the content and fine those involved, claiming the video aimed to inflame religious voters and discredit the candidacy.

item.title: Quando vai ser a votação do fim da escala 6x1?
item.description: The Brazilian Senate will vote on Wednesday on the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, reducing weekly hours from 44 to 40 without salary cuts, in the first round, with possible second round the same day. The vote takes place 11 days before the presidential election runoff and is seen as a political win for President Lula, especially following Flávio Bolsonaro's reaction, who initially criticized the proposal before declaring support.

item.title: Relatório da PF sobre envolvimento de ministros com Daniel Vorcaro fica para depois da eleição
item.description: The release of the PF report on STF ministers and Daniel Vorcaro was postponed to November, after the elections, to avoid turbulence. The decision, agreed between the PF and STF president Edson Fachin, aims to exhaustively analyze the mentioned names and submit the document to the PGR before forwarding it to the plenum. The case may be archived if there are insufficient elements to open investigations.

item.title: TSE manda Nikolas e Flávio apagarem vídeo com crianças contra Lula
item.description: The TSE ordered the removal of a video featuring children criticizing President Lula and the PT, posted by Nikolas Ferreira and Flávio Bolsonaro. Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze mandated the deletion of the posts within 24 hours in a preliminary analysis.

item.title: CDH debate políticas públicas voltadas à proteção de meninas nesta quinta
item.description: The Senate Human Rights Committee holds a public hearing to discuss the comprehensive protection of girls in Brazil, focusing on violence, education, health, and digital environment. Led by Senator Damares Alves, the initiative aims to strengthen public policies and reduce inequalities from early childhood.

item.title: Lula envia carta a evangélicos em busca de aproximação com segmento; Frente religiosa divulga texto
item.description: Lula sends a letter to evangelicals in an attempt to get closer, highlighting measures such as fighting online betting, two weekly rest days and family protection. The initiative seeks to gain support from an electorate where Lula has low participation, according to recent polls.

item.title: Família Reis se descola de Paes e rechaça apoio a Lula: 'Lá em casa até o papagaio vota no Flávio'
item.description: Washington Reis' family reaffirmed support for Flávio Bolsonaro, rejecting Eduardo Paes' alignment with Lula in the second round. Despite Jane Reis running as Paes' vice in Rio, the family maintained its vote for Flávio. Washington emphasized that 'even the parrot at home votes for Flávio', highlighting the split between his family and Paes.

item.title: 'SUS da Segurança' e fim da 'saidinha' para integrantes de facções: o que prevê a PEC da Segurança
item.description: The Senate Justice Committee approved the Public Security Constitutional Amendment, creating the Unified Public Security System and strengthening the fight against organized crime, restricting early release and expanding asset forfeiture for criminal factions. President Lula prioritizes security policies for his re-election campaign, focusing on stricter prison sentences and coordination between federal, state, and municipal authorities.

item.title: A nova pesquisa AtlasIntel sobre Lula x Flávio Bolsonaro, a 6 dias do 2º turno
item.description: The latest AtlasIntel poll, 6 days before the 2nd round, projects Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 52.8% of valid votes, against 47.2% for Lula (PT). The survey, interviewing 5,000 voters online with a one-point margin of error, will be released next Monday (19).

item.title: “Gostoso da Esplanada” rouba a cena em ato pró-Lula no DF e viraliza na web
item.description: During a pro-Lula rally in Brasília, a demonstrator nicknamed 'Gostoso da Esplanada' went viral on social media by mimicking the look of the 'Gostoso da Paulista'. The event gathered UnB students and Lula supporters backing his reelection and criticizing the far right.

item.title: CCJ do Senado aprova PEC da Segurança Pública de Lula
item.description: The Senate's CCJ approved the Public Security PEC, which creates the Single Public Security System and strengthens actions against organized crime. The matter moves to the Senate plenary, but there is no scheduled date for the final vote.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro volta atrás e diz que irá a debate presidencial da Band
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, running for president, reversed his earlier decision to skip a Band presidential debate, saying he will attend after Lula confirmed presence. He called his initial refusal an 'ambush' and criticized the political dynamics ahead of the election.

item.title: Aliados de Lula avaliam que virada depende de melhora nas pesquisas até sexta-feira; veja bastidor
item.description: Lula's allies assessed that a potential turnaround in the election depends on poll improvements by Friday. In a meeting with PT president Edinho Silva, they noted an increase in Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro internally, within just two percentage points. The mood has become more optimistic after supportive mobilizations, and social media strategy has been deemed successful.

item.title: PEC do fim da escala 6x1: equipe de Lula diz que conversão de Flávio Bolsonaro é falsa
item.description: Lula's team claims Flávio Bolsonaro's support for the 6x1 shift PEC is fake, calling it a strategy to reduce his electoral backlash. Minister José Guimarães stated that if elected, Flávio will push an alternative proposal favoring businesses. The PEC is scheduled for two voting rounds on the same Wednesday.

item.title: Quem é o ‘Gostoso da Paulista’? O homem que tirou a camisa e ficou só de moletom em ato pró-Lula
item.description: Israel Augusto Gomes dos Santos, 24, went viral after appearing shirtless at a pro-Lula rally on Paulista Avenue, gaining over 200,000 Instagram followers. Nicknamed 'Gostoso da Paulista', he is a human resources technologist who joked about being 'married to democracy'. His image reinforced youth support for Lula's public appearances.

item.title: JOTA Principal | Senado deve aprovar PEC do fim da escala 6×1, e PT usa tema para impulsionar campanha
item.description: The Senate is expected to approve the PEC ending the 6×1 work scale, a topic used by PT to boost its campaign. Flávio Bolsonaro changed position and supported the proposal, while critics highlight risks of unemployment and increased cost of living. Lula also announced debt forgiveness for MEIs, benefiting 3.6 million microentrepreneurs.

item.title: Custo do Pix de até R$ 5.000 para MEIs será de R$ 5 bilhões
item.description: The federal government announced a proposed support line for individual micro-entrepreneurs (MEIs), with direct transfers of up to R$ 5,000, allocating R$ 5 billion between 2027 and 2030, prioritizing women with lower revenues. The initiative, covering equipment purchases and productivity improvements, is set to launch in 2027 following elections, with details to be defined in consultation with Congress.

item.title: CCJ do Senado conclui aprovação da PEC da Segurança; texto vai ao plenário
item.description: The Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee approved the Public Security Amendment to the Constitution, which now moves to the plenary for final vote, aiming to establish the Unified Public Security System and create the Ministry of Public Security. The proposal includes strict measures against organized crime, such as imprisonment in higher-security regimes and asset seizure linked to criminal activities.

item.title: Flávio confirma presença no debate da “Band”: “Te espero, Lula”
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro confirmed his attendance at the Band debate scheduled for Sunday and challenged Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to attend. He stated he would go to debate to 'rub the truth in Lula's face' and refute him live. Following uncertainties about his participation, Lula confirmed his presence at the debate.

item.title: Comissão do Senado aprova PEC da Segurança
item.description: The Senate's Constitution and Justice Committee approved the Public Security Amendment Bill (PEC), which strengthens the Union's role in security and is a priority of President Lula's administration. The process concluded after rejecting amendments proposed by PL senators, including Carlos Portinho and Eduardo Gomes. Despite the committee approval, there is still no set date for the vote in the full Senate.

item.title: Flávio confirma ida a debate e diz que enganou Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) confirmed his participation in the debate with Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), scheduled for next Sunday, 18, after previously saying he would not attend. In an Instagram video, he admitted having misled Lula to ensure his confirmation.

item.title: A bomba K
item.description: The article criticizes Kassio Nunes Marques for following practices akin to those of Bolsonarismo during his tenure at the TSE, such as failing to remove misleading posts from the 'Exército do Lula' profile. It highlights the contradiction of those who criticize the supposed loss of sanity in the judiciary while replicating the same authoritarian methods they oppose.

item.title: 'Exército do Lula' sai do ar após ordem de Kassio e deve voltar após 48h
item.description: The WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', linked to Deputy André Janones, was temporarily suspended following a decision by TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques and is expected to resume operations within 48 hours.

item.title: Moro mobiliza 230 prefeitos e quase 3 mil lideranças do PR em ato de apoio a Flávio
item.description: Sergio Moro mobilized 230 mayors and nearly 3,000 PR leaders in Curitiba to support Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 election campaign, strengthening political alliances. The event aimed to consolidate key figures from PL backing the candidate.

item.title: Lula planeja ato no Planalto para celebrar fim da escala 6x1
item.description: President Lula plans an event at Planalto to celebrate the approval of the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, a key campaign priority. He is engaging with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to fast-track the legislation, which could be voted on in both rounds during the same session.

item.title: Tarcísio estreia em campanha de Flávio com viagem a Porto Alegre nesta 4ª
item.description: São Paulo governor Tarcísio de Freitas travels to Porto Alegre to support Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign, marking their first joint event outside the state. The partnership aims to strengthen alliances for the runoff election. Tarcísio had already endorsed Flávio after his re-election, reinforcing cooperation between the two leaders.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: entenda o que acontece se o Senado aprovar a proposta nesta quarta-feira
item.description: The Brazilian Senate is expected to vote Wednesday on the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, reducing weekly hours from 44 to 40. Approval will not immediately change rules, requiring a second vote, promulgation, and a 14-month transition. Flávio Bolsonaro announced support for the PEC after initial criticisms, while Lula attributes the shift to social pressure.

item.title: Lula divulga carta a evangélicos com defesa da família e fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Lula publishes letter to evangelicals emphasizing family protection, end of 6×1 shift, and betting ban, requesting votes guided by divine discernment. The campaign launches a WhatsApp channel focused on Christian values.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1 no plenário do Senado: entenda o que diz o texto e a regra de transição
item.description: The Senate president scheduled the vote on the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule, a key electoral pledge of Lula. The bill, already approved by the CCJ and the Chamber, reduces the weekly workhours from 44 to 40 over two years and ensures two paid weekly rest days. Flávio Bolsonaro publicly supported the initiative.

item.title: Campanha de Lula lança cartas direcionadas a evangélicos e católicos
item.description: Lula and the campaign will launch letters targeting evangelicals and Catholics to promote dialogue, replicating the 2022 initiative. The strategy is part of efforts to win voters traditionally aligned with the right.

item.title: A abstenção e o poder do voto de quem não votou - O Assunto #1824
item.description: The episode examines the record 33.5 million absent voters in the first round and how they could decide the runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Jairo Nicolau explains the profiles and reasons for non-voters, emphasizing the need for mobilization.

item.title: TSE julga ações sobre vídeos que ligam Lula e Flávio ao crime
item.description: The TSE judged four cases involving social media videos linking President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to criminal factions, ordering the removal of content deemed defamatory or lacking factual basis.

item.title: Votar PEC da Escala 6x1 é oportunismo
item.description: The government shows opportunism by scheduling the vote on the PEC that modifies the 6x1 work schedule for the Senate less than two weeks before the election runoff. The issue has been contaminated by electoral interests, harming a balanced debate on the proposal's economic impact in Brazil.

item.title: Canal 'Exército do Lula' sai do ar no WhatsApp após Nunes Marques estabelecer prazo de 48 horas para retomada
item.description: The 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel was suspended after TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques required its registration as an official campaign communication tool within 48 hours. The suspension occurred due to allegations of spreading fake news against Flávio Bolsonaro, though the rapporteur Cueva had restored the service before Nunes Marques overturned the decision. The broadcast list has 4.2 million followers and is managed by Congressman André Janones.

item.title: Pesquisa aponta que 42% da população quer acesso gratuito à cultura nos próximos anos
item.description: A survey by the Itaú Foundation found that 42% of the Brazilian population supports free cultural access as a priority. Class inequality and violence are the main obstacles to attending cultural events, with 63% of high-income classes going to the cinema compared to only 18% of lower-income classes. Insecurity and financial costs are the most cited barriers.

item.title: Primeira pesquisa Quaest do 2º turno será divulgada nesta quarta-feira (14)
item.description: Quaest will release its first poll for the 2026 presidential runoff on Wednesday (14), featuring Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT). The survey, commissioned by Globo and O Globo, interviewed 2,154 people from October 10 to 13, with a two-point margin of error. Datafolha will also publish a new poll this week, keeping the race statistically tied.

item.title: Eleições 2026: qual a diferença entre o primeiro e o segundo turno? Entenda e veja como votar
item.description: The 2026 runoff election on October 25 determines only the president and governor races in five states and the Federal District. Voters must bring ID and turn off devices, checking polling locations via the TSE website.

item.title: Aliados de Motta fazem contas para mantê-lo na presidência da Câmara e Centrão fala em ‘autopreservação’
item.description: Allies of the Chamber of Deputies president, Hugo Motta (Republicans-PB), are maneuvering to secure his reelection in 2025, relying on Centrão support and a self-preservation strategy. The PL, strengthened on the right, has already signaled interest in congressional leadership roles, but Centrão sectors believe over-concentration of power in one party would weaken the others. The race for the Chamber and Senate presidencies remains open, with key bargaining chips like amendments and committee positions already under negotiation.

item.title: Senado deve votar nesta quarta PEC que acaba com a escala 6x1
item.description: The Brazilian Senate will vote on Wednesday on the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, reducing the weekly workload from 44 to 40 hours and guaranteeing two paid rest days. The proposal, supported by both governing and opposition parties, is expected to be enacted by Thursday (22), ahead of the 2026 electoral runoff. Jair Bolsonaro’s ally Flávio Bolsonaro reversed his stance to support the measure, while Lula’s campaign considers it a priority.

item.title: Com pacote para MEI, Lula tenta se aproximar de público-alvo na eleição e se apropria de bandeira do bolsonarismo
item.description: Lula announced a $3.5 billion package for MEIs, including tax debt forgiveness and a commitment to $1,000 deposits starting in 2027, targeting strategic voters in the 2026 election against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Flávio deve votar fim da escala 6x1 à distância enquanto faz campanha com aliados em Porto Alegre
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is expected to vote remotely in favor of the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule while campaigning in Rio Grande do Sul. This marks a strategic shift after months of criticism toward the proposal, which he previously labeled opportunistic. Aligned with allies such as Tarcísio de Freitas and Sergio Moro, he aims to expand his voter base in the region.

item.title: Senado vota fim da escala 6x1: governo tenta aprovar PEC em dois turnos e oposição resiste; entenda estratégias
item.description: The Senate votes on Wednesday on the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, with the government attempting to pass it in two rounds the same day while the opposition insists on following the regular interval. The strategy aims to enact the measure before the second round of the election, with the opposition accusing the debate of being politically exploited. Flávio Bolsonaro announced support for the PEC but maintains criticism of how the voting process is being handled.

item.title: PEC da Segurança deve ser votada por comissão do Senado, mas análise no plenário é incerta
item.description: The Senate Constitution and Justice Committee is set to vote on the Security PEC, which had its merit approved in September but still awaits analysis of amendments. Despite the approval of the base text, there is no agreement to bring it to the floor yet. Senators from the base and opposition discuss changes, while Lula demands support from Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: As convicções elásticas de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro voted in favor of reducing the workday, after months aligned with pro-capital discourse. The article highlights a apparent contradiction between his traditional role as a defender of the business sector and this new stance as a defender of workers.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: Senado faz última sessão de debates e deve votar o texto hoje
item.description: The Senate will hold its final debate session and vote on the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule, replacing it with five workdays and two rest days. A special timeline will allow for enactment before the election runoff. Flávio Bolsonaro changed his stance and now supports the measure, aiding in vote gathering.
